defensiveAbilities.name: Deluge
defensiveAbilities.description: A creature can provoke a waterlogged tiddalik into laughing and releasing its stored water with a successful check to Basic DC 25 Performance a joke or funny story. The tiddalik also disgorges its water automatically if it dies while waterlogged, or can voluntarily Deluge as a three-action activity that has the concentrate trait. The mass of stored water swamps a 10ft Emanation, dealing 8d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage to creatures in the area (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save) and making the area difficult terrain for 1 day. The tiddalik can't use its spit Strike or Expel Wave until it next Drinks in Abundance.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drink Abundance
offensiveAbilities.description: The tiddalik spends a day or more drinking from a water source. If the water source is equal to or greater in volume than itself, the tiddalik consumes 5,000 gallons of water per day and becomes waterlogged. While waterlogged, it can use its spit Strike, Expel Wave, and its Deluge ability, but its Speed is reduced to 10 feet. If the water source is smaller than the tiddalik, it consumes the water but does not become waterlogged.

offensiveAbilities.name: Expel Wave
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The tiddalik is waterlogged

Effect The tiddalik expels a wave of water in a 60ft Cone that deals 6d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that fail the save are pushed back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical failure).

The tiddalik can't use Expel Wave again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
